questions.def: Use 'is' with singular subjects like 'she'.
questions.question: She ___ a student at this university.

questions.def: Use the simple past for completed actions in the past.
questions.question: They ___ the report yesterday.

questions.def: Use 'doesn't' with singular subjects like 'he'.
questions.question: He don't like to study late.

questions.def: Use present continuous for actions happening now.
questions.question: She ___ her thesis now.

questions.def: Use 'goes' with singular subjects in present simple.
questions.question: He ___ to the library after class.

questions.def: Use present perfect for experiences in the past.
questions.question: I ___ this book before.

questions.def: Use present simple for habits and facts.
questions.question: He ___ English very well.

questions.def: Use present perfect continuous for duration.
questions.question: They ___ here for five years.

questions.def: Use 'will' for future predictions with 'if'.
questions.question: She ___ the test if she studies.

questions.def: 'It' requires the singular form of the verb 'to be'.
questions.question: It ___ important to study hard.

questions.def: Use the simple past for completed past actions.
questions.question: The professor ___ a lecture yesterday.

questions.def: Use 'would' in conditional sentences (type 2).
questions.question: He ___ the answer if he knew.

questions.def: Use 'were' with plural subjects like 'they'.
questions.question: They was very happy yesterday.

questions.def: Use present perfect with 'already'.
questions.question: She ___ lunch already.

questions.def: Use 'am going' for planned future actions.
questions.question: I ___ to the meeting tomorrow.

questions.def: Use '-er' for short adjective comparatives.
questions.question: He is ___ than his brother.

questions.def: Use 'has' with singular subjects like 'she'.
questions.question: She have a lot of books.

questions.def: Use 'does' with singular subjects in present simple.
questions.question: He ___ his homework every day.

questions.def: Use 'want' with plural subjects in present simple.
questions.question: They ___ to finish the project on time.

questions.def: 'Best' is the superlative of 'good'.
questions.question: She is the ___ student in the class.

questions.def: Use the simple past for finished actions.
questions.question: She ___ a cake yesterday.

questions.def: 'Must' expresses obligation or necessity.
questions.question: We ___ be late for the exam.

questions.def: Use 'were' in conditional sentences (type 2).
questions.question: If I ___ you, I would study harder.

questions.def: Use past simple to describe where someone lived.
questions.question: He ___ in London last year.

questions.def: Use 'are' with plural nouns (books).
questions.question: The books ___ on the table.

questions.def: 'Less' is used with uncountable nouns like money.
questions.question: He has ___ money than me.

questions.def: Use the third-person singular 's' for present simple.
questions.question: She ___ that the Earth is round.

questions.def: 'Some' is used to show it is more than one result.
questions.question: The research shows ___ important results.

questions.def: 'Data' is plural, so we use 'are'.
questions.question: The data is showing a clear trend.

questions.def: We use past simple as the action is finished.
questions.question: He ___ three sources in his essay.
